speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: So it used to be at that point like one of the highest QPS services and over the years we kind of because all of our stack was just Node.js and Python so that was the natural choice at that point but in the subsequent years we have converted that into Go and it's still one of our highest QPS services at Uber.

zh: 所以我想，就像我加入的时候，对，就像我说的，我们当时只有两个服务，而且你回想那些日子，我们正处于那种超高速增长阶段，我们不断扩张到新的国家，不断扩展我们在出行领域的产品组合，后来我们推出了 Uber Eats，那也在不断扩张。

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
